cause_quote: The new binding saved `provider: model.provider` and `authRequirement` without a runtime, while the executor added `if (binding && (providerOverride !== binding.provider || cliExecution))`, rejecting a bound job whenever its session selected CLI execution.
user_saw: An automation created from a claude-cli conversation failed with an account-and-route incompatibility error, and after CLI account forwarding was fixed, its runtime could still change with the session override.
summary: The fix records and reuses the runtime alongside the account for new bindings and makes account errors more specific.
reasoning: The parent of #172590 already resolved the runtime from the session at execution time, and the first account-binding implementation left that lookup in place without recording a runtime. The runtime guarantee was therefore missing from the start of account binding. I checked that #180492 allowed CLI candidates that forwarded the recorded account but still left runtime selection to the session.
